name: kuraka-control
description: Kuraka Control Plane — local single-user dashboard to govern the Kuraka framework across consumer projects.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w packages/contracts run build && npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.test: npm -w backend run test && npm -w frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm -w backend run lint && npm -w frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w backend run typecheck && npm -w frontend run typecheck
